description: Kastra Edge clients: kastrahook (agent hook bridge), kastra-edge (CLI), kastra-mcp (read-only MCP server), kastra-mcp-gateway (policy-gated MCP wrapper)
notes: Kastra Edge installed. Next steps:
1. kastra-edge login          # authorize this device in your browser
2. kastra-edge install-hooks  # wire kastrahook into Claude Code
3. kastra-edge install-mcp    # register kastra-mcp in Claude Code
4. kastra-edge doctor         # verify PATH, hooks, login, connectivity
Optional, per agent:
kastra-edge install-cursor         # Cursor (v1.7+)
kastra-edge install-codex          # Codex CLI
kastra-edge install-hermes         # Hermes Agent
kastra-edge wrap-claude-desktop    # govern Claude Desktop's local MCP servers
Restart the agent afterwards so it re-reads its config.
Not available on Windows yet, and it refuses with an explanation:
sync-binaries. It copies the macOS desktop app's bundled CLIs onto
PATH; use `scoop update kastra-edge` to upgrade instead.
Known gaps on Windows:
* These binaries are not code-signed. SmartScreen may warn on first run.
* Your device handle is stored at %USERPROFILE%\.kastra\config.toml. It
is a long-lived credential. kastra-edge applies an owner-only ACL to
it (and any other credential-bearing config it writes), and repairs
a wider ACL back to owner-only automatically on the next read.
* Policy vocabulary: Claude Code on Windows names its shell tool
PowerShell, not Bash. A rule scoped tool eq "Bash" does not govern
Windows agents - write tool in "Bash,PowerShell".
Since 0.12.0, `kastra-edge scan` warns loudly when a history surface
cannot be read - take those warnings seriously.
